{{recipesummary|category=Casserole recipes|servings=4–6|time=Prep: 30–45 minutes
Baking: 15–30 minutes|difficulty=2 }} __NOTOC__ {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|United States cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Cajun cuisine|Cajun cuisine]] '''Mirliton casserole''' is a easy dish that works well as a side vegetable. It can be made with either [[Cookbook:Seafood|seafood]] or [[Cookbook:Meat|meat]], though it is most commonly made with [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp]] or [[Cookbook:Beef|ground beef]]. ==Ingredients== * 6 medium mirliton (chayote [[Cookbook:Squash|squash]]), halved lengthwise * 1 medium yellow [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] * 2–3 stalks [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] or diced * 1 medium to large green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], diced * 2–3 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) whole [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp]], peeled OR ½ lb (250 g) ground [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] (optional) * 1 [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaf]] * [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] * [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] * [[Cookbook:Parsley|Parsley]] * [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|Bread crumbs]] * 1 stick (½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] / 113 g) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] ([[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] may be substituted) ==Procedure== # Place mirliton halves seed-side up in a microwave- or oven-safe dish with approximately 1 inch (2.5cm) of water in the dish. Cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] (for oven) or [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|plastic wrap]] (for microwave) and cook in oven (350°F/175°C) or microwave (high at 10 minute intervals) until mirliton are soft enough to stick a fork or knife through easily. Allow mirliton to cool enough to be handled and dice into large pieces. # [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] onion, celery, and garlic in butter over medium heat, adding garlic to sauté just before onion, celery, and garlic are fully softened. # Add shrimp or beef to pan until beef is lightly browned or until shrimp is just turning pink. Skip this step if you aren't adding meat. # Incorporate mirliton and bay leaf and allow to [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 5–10 minutes. # Remove from heat and add salt, pepper, and parsley to taste. Pour mixture into a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole dish]] and cover with bread crumbs. # [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 350°F (175°C) until the mirliton is bubbling and the bread crumbs are browned.
